question: What are the numeric daily per-IP request and credit caps of Firecrawl's keyless tier?
why: docs.firecrawl.dev/rate-limits states the keyless tier is capped per IP address per day by a maximum number of requests and a maximum number of credits, and publishes neither value; docs.firecrawl.dev/billing calls the same tier capped per IP address per day rather than by a credit allotment, which contradicts the credit cap. The API source reads both from environment configuration (KEYLESS_REQUESTS_PER_DAY, KEYLESS_CREDITS_PER_DAY) with no defaults, so the deployed values are in neither page nor code. Only exhausting a cap would show a value, and no read-only probe does that.
